services: Professional development and networking for self-insured entities.
Education and training through monthly meetings and annual conference.
Workers' compensation policy and regulatory advocacy.
Member committee identification and tracking of legislative and regulatory activity.
Information sharing through educational programs, newsletters, bulletins, website, and events.
Advocacy and amicus curiae activity on issues affecting self-insurers and workers' compensation.
audiences: Professionals and companies representing self-insured employers and compatible interests.
service_area: Arizona statewide workers' compensation and self-insurance community.
address: Official current contact page lists Arizona Self Insurers Association, Attn: Karolyn Kiburz, CMP, Meetings & Concierges Source, 4300 N. Miller Rd. #141, Scottsdale, AZ 85251.
Local business.json and Greater Phoenix Chamber listing list 7375 E. 6th Ave., Ste. 9, Scottsdale, AZ 85251.
phone: Local business.json and Greater Phoenix Chamber phone: 480-706-5762.
confirmed_facts.hours: Public office hours were not found on the official pages reviewed; official site publishes event dates instead.
differentiators: Official about page says ASIA was established in 1983.
Official home page says ASIA is the only employer association actively involved in the legislative and regulatory workers' compensation process in Arizona.
Official about page says ASIA is affiliated with the National Council of Self-Insurers.
Official membership page lists self-insured and associate membership categories.
trust_signals: Official site publishes current phone and contact address.
National Council of Self-Insurers lists ASIA among state self-insured association members.
Greater Phoenix Chamber listing corroborates association category and mission description.
pricing_notes: Official pages say annual membership dues and event costs may be paid online, but a dues schedule amount was not visible in reviewed text.
Official event examples list paid registration and sponsorship opportunities; verify current event and dues pricing before publishing.
